title: Custom football kits for your team: the complete guide (2026)
meta_title: Custom Football Kits for Your Team: Complete Guide | MOMUTO
meta_descript: Kit out your team: 3 ways to design custom football kits (soccer uniforms), how to pick fabric and printing, when to order and how to fund it. From €21.90.
content:
Quick answer

A custom football kit (soccer uniform) is a jersey built around your team’s identity — colours, crest, sponsors, names and numbers — and made with full dye-sublimation. At MOMUTO there are three routes: the free 3D configurator, the Ready-to-Play collection, or a custom design (€15 to start, credited from 5 jerseys — fully refundable if the first concept isn’t right). First draft in 24–48 h, delivery in 25–30 days, no minimum order. For a September season start, order before mid-August.

What is a custom football kit?

It is the opposite of a catalogue. Instead of a generic template with a crest slapped on top, it is a jersey designed around your team: your colours, your crest, your sponsors, and a cut fitted to a real squad (from kids’ XS to adult 4XL). It is made with full dye-sublimation — the ink fuses into the fibre, never on top — for unlimited artwork and real durability. See printing & materials.

Got an AI-generated design (ChatGPT, Gemini, Midjourney)? Our designers turn it into a production-ready kit. Read: from AI to a real jersey.

Getting it right: fabric, printing, sizing

A kit that lasts a season of washes is a polyester/elastane blend (not 100% polyester) printed by full dye-sublimation, so the design never cracks or peels. Sizing runs from kids’ XS to adult 4XL, which lets you dress a whole club in one order. See the size guide · choosing your colours.

When to order: the season calendar

Most leagues kick off in late summer. With 25–30 days from order to delivery, the useful window is mid-July to mid-August — ideally lock the design in June. Cutting it fine, or ordering mid-season for a tournament? See when to order your team kits.

The budget: sponsors and fundraising

Most grassroots teams don’t pay for kit out of pocket — they fund it. Sublimation prints a local sponsor’s logo into the fabric (chest, sleeve, back) at no extra cost, and one sponsor often covers a large part of a squad order. Full playbook: fund your team kits with sponsors and fundraising.

By format of play

  • Amateur & grassroots club — full 11-a-side squad, one identity.
  • Futsal & 5-a-side — lighter kits for the indoor game.
  • 7-a-side & Sunday league — small-sided teams, no minimum order.
  • Corporate & events — company teams, tournaments, brand activations.
  • Tournaments — one-off kits for a weekend or a cup run.

Frequently asked questions

Is there a minimum order for team kits?

No. You can order anything from a single jersey to a full squad. The per-jersey price drops with quantity: from €38.90 for one down to €21.90/jersey from 10.

How far ahead of the season should we order?

Allow 25–30 days between order and delivery. For a mid-September start, order before mid-August; ideally validate the design in June–July.

Can we print sponsor logos on the kit?

Yes. Sublimation prints every logo into the fabric — chest, sleeves and back — with no peeling and no extra cost per logo.

Do you ship to the US?

Yes. MOMUTO ships worldwide, including the US, with the same 25–30 day window. Prices are shown in euros and converted at checkout.
